info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Models API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Models API facilitates the creation and management of trading models tailored for wholesale market operations. This endpoint allows financial institutions and trading firms to define and optimize their trading strategies, ensuring they meet their specific operational requirements. Consumers of this API typically include financial analysts and trading platform developers who seek to implement dynamic trading models in their systems. By using this API, users can enhance their trading capabilities and improve decision-making processes within the wholesale trading context.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new trading model within the wholesale trading system. A trading model defines the rules and parameters for executing trades, enabling automated trading strategies tailored to specific market conditions.

requestBody.description: The body of the request contains the trading model information that you want to create or update in the wholesale trading system. Ensure that the provided JSON adheres to the required schema for successful processing.
